01 About us

A veterinary-focused company, built around real practice.

Cavera is a veterinary-focused company dedicated to developing and providing innovative, reliable, and high-quality solutions for animal health and care.

Our approach combines scientific knowledge, practical veterinary needs, and a strong commitment to quality, to deliver products that support veterinarians, pet owners, and animal well-being.

At Cavera, we believe that better animal care starts with better solutions.

02 Our vision

A trusted name in veterinary healthcare.

To become a trusted and recognized name in the veterinary healthcare market by delivering high-quality products and meaningful solutions that improve animal care.

03 Our mission

Effective, safe and practical veterinary products.

Our mission is to develop and provide effective, safe and practical veterinary products that meet the evolving needs of veterinarians and animal owners.

02 The product line

Three products, one silver-and-chlorhexidine idea.

Chlorhexidine and nano silver work on the skin's bacterial balance; aloe vera and panthenol keep it moisturised and calm. The difference between the three is how you get the formula onto the animal.

Skin & wound care · 100 ml

Silver-AG Spray

A no-touch antiseptic spray for wounds, hot spots and irritated patches. Useful where the skin is too sore to handle.

  • Chlorhexidine
  • Nano silver
  • Aloe vera
  • Panthenol
Cavera · Topical · 100 ml Silver-AG Spray A no-touch antiseptic spray for wounds, hot spots and irritated patches. Useful where the skin is too sore to handle.
Read the label
Description

A topical preparation for skin care where the skin's bacterial balance has been disturbed. It moisturises the skin and reduces irritation, and with chlorhexidine and nano silver it supports the skin's own regeneration and wound-healing processes.

It also helps reduce itching and soothes inflammation.

Suitable for

All animals.

How to use

Spray directly onto the affected area of the animal's skin from a distance of 15-20 cm.

Repeat as needed, or as directed by a veterinarian.

Composition

Active ingredients

  • Chlorhexidine
  • Nano silver
  • Aloe vera
  • Panthenol

Plus other ingredients.

Pack

  • Size100 ml
  • FormSpray
  • RouteTopical, external use
Safety

Precautions

  • For external use only.
  • Avoid contact with the eyes and mucous membranes.
  • Prevent excessive licking after application.
  • If irritation or an adverse reaction occurs, stop use and consult a veterinarian.
  • Keep out of reach of children.

Storage

  • Store in a dry, cool place, out of sunlight.
  • Do not refrigerate.

Skin & wound care · 100 ml

Silver-AG Hydrogel

The same silver-and-chlorhexidine formula in a form that stays put, for targeted work on a defined lesion.

  • Chlorhexidine
  • Nano silver
  • Aloe vera
  • Panthenol
Cavera · Topical · 100 ml Silver-AG Hydrogel The same silver-and-chlorhexidine formula in a form that stays put, for targeted work on a defined lesion.

Dermatology · 150 ml

Dermo Care Shampoo

A gentle antiseptic foam shampoo for dogs and cats, cleansing for a whole coat rather than a single spot.

  • Chlorhexidine 2%
  • Panthenol
  • Aloe vera
  • Glycerin
  • Allantoin
Cavera · Medicated shampoo · 150 ml Dermo Care Shampoo A gentle antiseptic foam shampoo for dogs and cats, cleansing for a whole coat rather than a single spot.
Read the label
Description

A gentle antiseptic foam shampoo formulated for dogs and cats. It cleanses effectively while helping to control bacterial, fungal and skin infections.

Enriched with chlorhexidine 2%, panthenol, aloe vera, glycerin and allantoin, it moisturises, soothes irritated skin, supports the skin barrier, and promotes a healthy, shiny coat.

Recommended for

  • Wounds
  • Hot spots
  • Allergies (flea, contact and hereditary)
How to use

Wet the coat and skin thoroughly. Work the foam into the coat and skin, massaging well so it reaches the skin itself. Leave on the animal for 5-10 minutes, then rinse well.

Apply twice weekly until the skin condition improves, then once weekly to maintain healthy skin.

Age

For dogs and cats from 12 weeks of age.

Composition

Key ingredients

  • Chlorhexidine 2%
  • Panthenol
  • Aloe vera
  • Glycerin
  • Allantoin

Pack

  • Size150 ml
  • FormFoam shampoo
  • RouteTopical, dogs and cats only
Safety

Precautions

  • Read the directions before use.
  • For topical use on dogs and cats only.
  • Keep out of reach of children.

Storage

  • Store in the original container, away from direct sunlight.

Batch number, manufacturing and expiry dates and registration number are printed on each pack. Veterinary products: use as directed, and consult a veterinarian if you are unsure.

Approach

How a Cavera product gets made: the questions we ask first, the standards we hold it to, and where the portfolio is heading.

01 Product development

From veterinary needs to practical solutions.

At Cavera, product development starts with understanding the real challenges faced by veterinary professionals. We look at clinical needs, everyday product usability, formulation requirements, and market expectations to identify opportunities for meaningful solutions.

Identify
Develop
Evaluate
Improve
Deliver

A successful veterinary product should combine scientific rationale with practical usability.

02 Quality commitment

Quality is at the heart of everything we do.

We work with specialized manufacturing partners and focus on appropriate raw material selection, formulation quality, manufacturing processes, packing, and product consistency.

Our goal is to build products that veterinary professionals can confidently incorporate into their daily practice.

03 Understanding veterinarians

Built around the real-world needs of veterinary professionals.

We believe that successful veterinary products should not only be scientifically sound, but also practical, easy to use, and relevant to everyday clinical situations.

That's why veterinary insight is an essential part of our approach to product development.

04 Our future

A growing portfolio, a long-term vision.

Cavera is building a growing portfolio of veterinary solutions with a long-term vision for sustainable growth. Our future focus includes:

Expanding our veterinary product portfolio
Developing innovative formulations
Strengthening our distribution network
Building partnerships with veterinary professionals
Expanding into new markets

Our ambition is simple: to make Cavera a trusted partner in veterinary care.

Our clinic

Easy Vet: care that comes to you.

Cavera is the parent company of Easy Vet, a veterinary clinic serving pets and their owners in Cairo. One group, two sides of the same work.

01 One group

Products on one side, practice on the other.

Most product companies have to guess at what a clinic day actually looks like. We don't have to. Easy Vet gives Cavera a standing view of how products get used, and what still isn't good enough.

Products

Cavera

Develops and supplies veterinary skin, wound and hygiene products for veterinarians, distributors and pet owners.

Practice

Easy Vet

Treats dogs and cats every day, and feeds real clinical experience back into what Cavera builds next.

02 At the clinic

The first mobile veterinary clinic in the Egyptian market.

Easy Vet treats every animal that comes to it as one of the family. Care can come to your door, or your pet can stay with us. Either way, dogs and cats are looked after by people who do this every day.

Consultations & diagnostics

Clinical examination and diagnostic work-up, including portable ultrasound at your home.

Surgery

Routine and general surgical procedures for dogs and cats.

Preventive care

Wellness checks, vaccination, deworming, and internal and external parasite control.

In-patient care

Hospital care and monitoring for acute injuries and illness.

Boarding

Pet hosting designed around the animal's physical and emotional comfort.

Grooming & hygiene

Bathing, nail trimming and ear cleaning: routine care that keeps skin problems away.

Pet care, anywhere.
